metadata.summary: Honeymoons are for newlyweds celebrating true love and for future NFL head coaches plotting Super Bowl glory. At least in the case of Mike Macdonald, who has now turned to the Chicago Bulls as his recipe reference for a repeat.
metadata.content: Seattle Seahawks: Jaxon Smith-Njigba's NFL warning, Mike Macdonald's honeymoon vision and the Super Bowl champions' quest for repeat | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to content Exclusive Seattle Seahawks: Jaxon Smith-Njigba's NFL warning, Mike Macdonald's honeymoon vision and the Super Bowl champions' quest for repeat Seattle Seahawks wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba says Sam Darnold 'shut up the naysayers' by leading his side to Super Bowl glory; Darnold and Smith-Njigba's Seahawks open the 2026 NFL season against the New England Patriots on Wednesday night, live on Sky Sports from 1.20am Thursday Tuesday 8 September 2026 15:24, UK Honeymoons are for newlyweds celebrating true love and for future NFL head coaches plotting Super Bowl glory. At least in the case of Mike Macdonald, who has now turned to the Chicago Bulls as his recipe reference for a repeat. Mystic Macdonald went viral earlier this year when the Seattle Seahawks released footage of his first-ever team meeting upon being appointed in 2024. Within it, he had strayed from his script to forecast a place at the NFC Championship Game and an 'inevitable' feel to a 'won't die, won't quit' machine. "It probably came to me about 30 minutes before the meeting," Macdonald tells Sky Sports of his viral speech. Between some fine fortune-telling and a relentless winning formula, that vision became a reality 21 months later as Seattle beat the Los Angeles Rams to reach Super Bowl LX. messages.text: Hull 'buzzing' for Team Europe return | 'She embraces the Solheim!'

metadata.summary: Anna Nordqvist says Charley Hull is "buzzing" to tee it at the Solheim Cup this week and is pleased to see the Englishwoman embrace her growing role for Team Europe.
metadata.content: Solheim Cup 2026: Charley Hull 'buzzing' for Team Europe return as Anna Nordqvist explains practice tee time mistake | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to content Solheim Cup 2026: Charley Hull 'buzzing' for Team Europe return as Anna Nordqvist explains practice tee time mistake Charley Hull makes her eighth consecutive appearance for Team Europe at the Solheim Cup; Anna Nordqvist and Mel Reid reflected on Hull being late to her practice tee time in their pre-tournament press conference; watch Solheim Cup live on Friday from 6am on Sky Sports Golf By Ali Stafford at Bernardus Golf Tuesday 8 September 2026 23:29, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Starting from a 17-year old debutant all the way to one Europe's superstars, watch the best moments from Charley Hull's Solheim Cup career Anna Nordqvist says Charley Hull is "buzzing" to tee it at the Solheim Cup this week and is pleased to see the Englishwoman embrace her growing role for Team Europe. It seems ludicrous to refer to a 30-year-old as a 'veteran' but it's a title fitting to Hull's experience in Solheim Cups, given this week's appearance at Bernardus Golf is her eighth in a row for Team Europe. Her Solheim Cup highlights include top-scoring for Europe during the 2015 contest and finishing unbeaten in the Gleneagles victory in 2019, with Hull also thrashing world No 1 Nelly Korda 6&4 on the final day of the last contest.
